gui.method: Computer Use: empty typed.md, click blank line, type each row with typeText and physical Return between rows; no prebuilt table or multiline paste
gui.observed: Three ordinary text paragraphs, no table. Cmd-S then Esc left the same text. Saved bytes contain blank lines between paragraphs and leading backslashes on header and delimiter rows.
gui.comparison: Opened source.md containing the unescaped three contiguous lines: AX table, header and five data cells (1,2,3,4,5) rendered normally.
gui.exit: App menu Quit via session.finish; PID absent and preview residue 0 checked separately
gui.limits: Debug isolated app, ASCII input with Enter; Shift-Enter, physical IME, installed/public Release and other row shapes were not tested

conclusion: Table import works. Live Markdown-to-table typing conversion is absent. The leading backslashes can be generated by saving typed text, so they do not establish a user typo.
